gaps.requirement: UC12-1; DELIVERABLE12-1 — Parse USMTF raw text into the three-category synchronized 24-hour schedule.
gaps.evidence: public/domain.mjs accepts only SYN-OPTASK/1 with an invented banner and FREQPLAN/CRYPTO/FLIGHTQ grammar. format-boundary.test.mjs explicitly asserts rejection of USMTF. domain.test.mjs tests the substitute grammar, not format-conforming mock messages. verification.md acknowledges the missing documented USMTF subset and reviewed mapping. Preserve original test expectations; do not alter the frozen acceptance plan to obtain a pass.

gaps.requirement: MSG-05 — Keep the timeline usable offline

gaps.fix: Add an integration test that activates the cache, actually disconnects browser networking, reloads the workspace, parses newly changed synthetic input, and saves, reviews and downloads its schedule. Assert the downloaded event values and original text, and record execution evidence.
